title: cloudpilot-ai-aws-services: fail-open auth (API_KEY unset -> /api/chat & /api/approve open)
claim: When CLOUDPILOT_API_KEY is unset, authenticate_request returns True for every request, so /api/chat and /api/approve (which gate destructive AWS actions terminate_ec2/delete_rds/delete_lambda) are reachable without any credential.
ceiling: Source-confirmed from code (web.py L88 `if not API_KEY: return True`; L1058/L1100 call it). Runtime loopback verification pending: needs boto3 env + service start. README default binds 127.0.0.1 (loopback, NOT remote). Impact = local reach + default creds admin/cloudpilot123 if env unset.

oracle.evidence: __MARKER__ in {body} or status 200 without X-API-Key header

provenance.notes: Source-confirmed candidate. --exec requires starting the app with API_KEY unset on 127.0.0.1:8000 (boto3 deps). Not yet runtime-verified.
